fields.title: palaugov.pw ROP Procurement tender record
fields.description: One record per row across all three procurement category tables (BHR, CIP, Other Organizations). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: Always CURRENT_TENDER -- this site publishes only currently-open tenders, no historical archive.

category.title: Category
category.description: Which of the three upstream tables this came from: 'BHR' (routine procurement), 'CIP' (Capital Improvement Projects), or 'Other Organizations'.

referenceNumber.title: Bid/RFP number
referenceNumber.description: The government's own reference code for this solicitation.

noticeUrl.title: Notice PDF URL
noticeUrl.description: Direct link to the tender's official PDF notice.

openingDate.title: Opening date
openingDate.description: Upstream free-text date the solicitation opened.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns -- rows missing a given column render blank.
